name: Reproduction
overview: When compared with animals, sexual reproduction is less complex in flowering plants. Reproduction may occur in higher plants from their vegetative parts (leaves, stems, roots). In sexual reproduction only half of each parent’s chromosomes are passed to the next generation.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: When compared with animals, sexual _____ is less complex in flowering plants.
vsaq.answer: When compared with animals, sexual reproduction is less complex in flowering plants.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Unlike mitosis which is a continuous process for _____ in most of the cells.
vsaq.answer: Unlike mitosis which is a continuous process for division in most of the cells.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: During meiosis the parent cell divides twice and four daughter _____ are formed.
vsaq.answer: During meiosis the parent cell divides twice and four daughter cells are formed.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The second phase of meiosis is similar to normal _____.
vsaq.answer: The second phase of meiosis is similar to normal mitosis.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Cell organelles _____ and prepare chromosome for mitosis.
vsaq.answer: Cell organelles divide and prepare chromosome for mitosis.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: These are the _____ spores produced by fungus.
vsaq.answer: These are the reproductive spores produced by fungus.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The _____ act always has potential to lead to pregnancy.
vsaq.answer: The sexual act always has potential to lead to pregnancy.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Tissue culture is a modern technique of growing _____.
vsaq.answer: Tissue culture is a modern technique of growing plants.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: After fertilisation, the zygote divides several times to form an _____ within the ovule.
vsaq.answer: After fertilisation, the zygote divides several times to form an embryo within the ovule.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The given diagram shows two _____ in the pollen tube.
vsaq.answer: The given diagram shows two nuclei in the pollen tube.

saq.question: Explain reproduction and conditions with reference to Reproduction.
saq.answer: The time required to reproduce also varies from organism to organism. Even within the organism there could be certain environmental conditions that would make the process of reproduction faster.

saq.question: Explain reproduction and insects with reference to Reproduction.
saq.answer: During rainy season you may have wondered to see how swarms of insects suddenly appear. Most insects have life cycles spanning a few days to a few months. You will find great variations in the periods of reproduction viz. yeasts, bacteria, rat, cow, elephant and man.

saq.question: Explain produce and fruits with reference to Reproduction.
saq.answer: If you have two varieties of same type of fruit yielding trees in your garden. One tree has the character of giving big sized fruits but less in number. The other one produce more number of small sized fruits.

saq.question: Explain microscope and controlled with reference to Reproduction.
saq.answer: To examine Rhizopus or common mold under the microscope, it is best to grow on your own in a controlled environment. Use a soft bread or a roti, fruits or vegetables. A good sample of mold may require 4-10 days should not be done by those with allergies to mold or with severe asthma.)

saq.question: Explain Place and inside with reference to Reproduction.
saq.answer: Leave the bread in the open air for about an hour, so it is exposed to contaminants in the air. Place the bread in a plastic bag, sprinkle water over it to have dampness, then seal the bag, leaving some air inside. Place the bag in a dark, warm place. A kitchen cup board close to the stove may be one option. Or you could place it next to a window, with a bowl or lid covering it from the light. Mold will grow best in a moist environment.
